title: تحلیل شخصیت
description:
Create a very professional, modern, and minimalist infographic in Persian that looks like a “personality analysis and facial first impression assessment report.”
Place the person’s photo in the center of the page.
Around the photo, use lines and arrows to identify different facial features (eyes, eyebrows, face shape, jawline, lips, nose, head angle, gaze, and symmetry), and write a short explanation for each section describing what first impression this feature creates.
On the right side of the page, place a panel with rating bars (0–10) including:
• Visual calmness
• Apparent self-confidence
• Determination in gaze
• Emotional control
• Sociability (first impression)
• Formal appearance
• Facial friendliness
• Charisma
• Presence and impact
• Trustworthiness in the gaze
• Attention to detail (first impression)
• Overall facial harmony
At the bottom of the page, display an overall score:
“Overall First Impression: 7.8 / 10”
Next to it, write a 4–5 line analytical summary.
At the bottom right, add a section titled “Potential Strengths” including:
• Calm appearance
• Focused gaze
• Noticeable presence
• Balanced facial features
• Dignity
At the bottom left, add a section titled “Areas for Improvement in First Impression” including:
• More smiling
• Warmer eye contact
• Clothing color selection
• More open body language
• Friendlier posture
At the bottom of the page, add a section titled “Communication Suggestions” with several short recommendations for creating a better first impression.
The design should look exactly like a professional psychology and facial assessment report:
White background
Blue and gray color palette
Minimal icons
Modern Persian-style typography
Clean layout
Guideline lines over the face
Formal and professional report appearance
At the bottom of the page, write in small font:
“This report is only based on the initial impression from visible facial features and does not determine a person’s actual personality.”

title: گل
description: Дорогой lifestyle момент, но снят случайно, как сторис без каких либо табличек. Фотореализм, фото снято на iPhone 17 pro max, нет идеальной симметрии нет «постановочного» ощущения,фото  9:16. Крупный план. Макияж со стрелками и пышными ресницами вытянутыми к виску, глянцевые губы розоватого оттенка и легкий румянец, кожа слегка обожжена солнцем, лето она на зеленом лугу с колосьями. title: کلاه
description: Не меняй внешность девушки с фото. Селфи на фронтальную камеру сверху вниз, крупный план. Девушка лежит на черном шезлонге, на спине, её лицо частично скрыто. Губы слегка сложены в кокетливый жест  «уточкой». Кожа слегка загорелого оттенка, длинные ресницы лисий эффект, блеск на губах. К лицу поднесена правая рука с длинными острыми ногтями, маникюр молочный френч. В ухе виден белый беспроводной наушник. На голову надета черная бейсболка, низко надвинутая на глаза. На шее надета тонкая изящная цепочка с небольшим сердечком , инкрустированным мелкими блестящими камнями или стразами. На девушке черный укороченный топ без бретелек. Освещение очень яркое, контрастное солнцечное. Козырек кепки отбрасывает плотную темную тень, полностью закрывающую глаза, а на загорелой коже в области ключиц и плеч видны резкие графичные тени. На фоне слегка видно зеленый газон. ультрареалистичный снимок. высокая детализация текстур кожи.  снято на камеру Iphone 17 pro, эффект живого кадра. Легкий цифоровой шум, зернистость, мягкая резкость. Очень высокое качество. 9:16

title: تبلیغ محصول
description:
پرامپت تبلیغ لوکس محصول روی مدل

ULTIMATE UNIVERSAL LUXURY PRODUCT-TO-MODEL EDITORIAL ADVERTISING PROMPT

You are the Creative Director, Luxury Fashion Art Director, Senior Commercial Photographer, Product Stylist, CGI Artist, Fashion Editor, Advertising Producer, Visual Merchandiser, and High-End Retoucher behind campaigns for the world's most prestigious luxury brands including Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Chanel, Prada, Saint Laurent, Loewe, Bottega Veneta, Gucci, Celine, Jacquemus, and Ralph Lauren.

Your mission is to transform ONE uploaded product photo into a premium luxury advertising campaign.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
Analyze the uploaded image and automatically determine:
- What the product is.
- How it should naturally be worn or used.
- Whether the appropriate model should be male or female.
- Which pose best showcases the product.
- Which luxury environment best fits the product.
- Which styling best emphasizes the product.
Never ask for clarification. Automatically make the best artistic decision.

PRODUCT PRESERVATION (MOST IMPORTANT)
The uploaded product is the ONLY reference.
Do NOT redesign it. Do NOT improve it. Do NOT reinterpret it. Do NOT replace any details.
Preserve exactly: colors, proportions, stitching, logo, branding, shape, texture, patterns, hardware, materials, embroidery, prints, accessories, construction, finish.
Everything must remain identical to the uploaded product. The product must look like the exact physical item.

INTELLIGENT PRODUCT DETECTION
Automatically recognize what has been uploaded. Examples include but are not limited to: Handbag, Tote bag, Backpack, Wallet, Shoes, Sneakers, Boots, Sandals, Slippers, Socks, Dress, Jacket, T-shirt, Hoodie, Jeans, Suit, Hat, Cap, Scarf, Sunglasses, Ring, Necklace, Bracelet, Watch, Earrings, Belt, Perfume, Cosmetic products, Home accessories, Lifestyle products, Fashion accessories.
Then naturally place the product where it belongs. Examples: Shoes -> on feet, Ring -> on hand, Bracelet -> on wrist, Watch -> on wrist, Necklace -> around neck, Hat -> on head, Bag -> carried naturally, Dress -> worn naturally, Jacket -> worn naturally, Scarf -> styled elegantly, Sunglasses -> worn naturally.
Never force unnatural placement.

MODEL DIRECTION
Automatically determine whether the product is intended for: Male, Female, Unisex. Choose the appropriate professional fashion model accordingly.
The model exists only to present the product. The model is NEVER the subject. The PRODUCT is always the hero.

FACE VISIBILITY (STRICT RULE)
Never reveal the model's identity. The face must NEVER be recognizable.
Use one of these compositions: Back facing camera, Looking away, Hair covering the face, Cropped from shoulders down, Cropped from neck down, Face hidden behind the product, Side silhouette with no facial details, Face outside the frame.
The model must remain anonymous.

PRODUCT IS THE HERO
Everything in the composition must emphasize the product. The viewer's eye should immediately focus on the product.
Use: Professional posing, Natural body language, Elegant hand placement, Luxury styling, Luxury posture.
No distracting expressions. No dramatic gestures. No unnecessary accessories.

EDITORIAL LAYOUT
Create a premium luxury editorial composition inspired by high-end fashion magazines.
Main hero image should occupy approximately 70% of the canvas. Around the hero image, include multiple premium detail panels showcasing the product.
Include close-up shots of: Front, Back, Side, Top, Bottom (when relevant), Interior (when relevant), Texture, Material, Stitching, Hardware, Logo, Fabric, Pattern, Print, Closure, Handle, Sole, Heel, Zipper, Buttons, Lining, Buckles, Craftsmanship, Any unique premium details.
Every detail image must look like it was professionally photographed. The collage should feel elegant, clean, balanced, and luxurious.

title: مدل مو
description:
You are a professional AI hairstyle simulation expert.

First, ask the user to upload a clear, high-quality, front-facing photo of themselves.
The photo must have good lighting, the entire face must be clearly visible, and as much of the hair as possible should be visible.

After receiving the photo, generate one single composite image containing 10 versions of the same person, each featuring a completely different women's hairstyle.

Output Requirements

The final output must be only one image.

The image must contain 10 copies of the same person.

Arrange them in a clean, professional layout, preferably a 2-row × 5-column grid.

In every panel, the person's face and identity must remain exactly the same, while only the hairstyle changes.

Under each version, display the hairstyle name in a small, clean, minimalist font.

Do not place any other text on the image.


Diversity Requirements

The 10 hairstyles must be clearly and dramatically different from one another. Avoid making only subtle variations of similar styles.

The differences should include a wide variety of:

Hair length (very short to very long)

Straight vs. curly hair

Loose vs. tied hairstyles

Bangs vs. no bangs

Middle part vs. side part

Hair volume

Layered vs. blunt cuts

Updos

Braided hairstyles


Each hairstyle should be instantly distinguishable from the others at first glance.

Critical Rules

The person's identity must remain exactly the same.

Do not modify:

Face shape

Eyes

Eyebrows

Nose

Lips

Jawline

Ears

Skin tone

Facial features

Age

Facial expression

Body shape

Clothing

Pose

Camera angle

Lighting

Background


Only the following may change:

Hairstyle

Hair length

Hair volume

Hair texture

Hair arrangement

Hair part

Bang style

Hair styling


Hair must appear natural and realistic, with believable density, texture, shine, and a natural-looking hairline.

Do not introduce exaggerated beauty edits, facial modifications, makeup changes, or overall style alterations.

The final image must be photorealistic, clean, high-resolution, and professionally rendered.

Required Hairstyles

1. Pixie Cut


2. Blunt Bob


3. French Bob with Bangs


4. Long Straight Hair with Middle Part


5. Butterfly Cut


6. Voluminous Soft Curls


7. Beach Waves


8. High Ponytail


9. Low Bun with Face-Framing Strands


10. Braided Crown Hairstyle



Final Instruction

Before generating the image, analyze the person's face shape, hair type, hair density, hair texture, and overall appearance, then adapt each hairstyle so it looks realistic, flattering, and naturally suited to that individual.

Ensure that:

The person's identity remains identical in all 10 versions.

Only the hairstyle changes.

All 10 hairstyles are visually distinct from one another.

The output is one high-resolution composite image displaying the same person with 10 completely different women's hairstyle
